proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 1562 article gives Malayalam ciri laughter; cirikka to laugh; kiṟikkuka to show the teeth, grin.. The Byari survey form ciri “laugh” is proposed within this article family. Lindgren assigns the corresponding Tamil reflex to the same source cognate set.
